identity: Nearby terrain can be turned into fields if it is completely cleared of terrain that isn't grass or dirt.  Doing so makes that terrain eligible for usage for standard base camp expansion.  Note that log cutting does this conversion automatically when the trees are depleted, but not all terrain can be logged.

identity:
I32 was provided an air-gapped, recently-formatted desktop on which a series of text files containing a set of alphanumeric codes had been entered, as well as a notebook and a pen.  The desktop was not equipped with either a mouse, a keyboard, or a monitor.  Despite these limitations, I32 began writing after 23 seconds and within two minutes had transcribed the complete sequence of codes.

For the follow-up, I23 was provided with the same materials but had no physical access to the desktop.  Timing was similar to the first iteration of the experiment (22 seconds).

For a second follow-up, I32 also had no line of sight to the desktop due to it being placed in an adjacent room.  While I32 did eventually transcribe the sequence successfully, it took significantly longer (1 minute 15 seconds).  A further experiment to see if a Faraday cage or a shield of particular materials can block the effect is in the planning stage.
